Status

FinKore Core 2.0.3 stable.

Purpose

This document defines initial portable approval failure categories.

Error Codes

CodeMeaning
FINKORE_APPROVAL_REQUIREDA domain action requires approval that is not satisfied.
FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_DECISIONA proposed decision is missing, malformed, or not permitted.
FINKORE_APPROVAL_INELIGIBLE_ACTORThe deciding actor does not satisfy the requirement.
FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAINA chain or composition definition, or its required evaluation evidence, is invalid.
FINKORE_APPROVAL_CONDITION_UNRESOLVEDA required condition cannot be evaluated from available facts.
FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CONTEXTRequired explicit evaluation context for Approval validity is missing or malformed.

Requirements

  • APPROVAL-ERROR-001 — A failed Approval Decision MUST NOT change an Approval Requirement or Approval Chain outcome.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-002 — Error details MAY identify the affected requirement.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-004 — Error details MUST NOT disclose restricted eligibility or decision data.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-005 — A failed Approval operation MUST leave existing committed Approval Decisions unchanged.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-006 — A failed Approval lifecycle operation MUST leave existing committed Approval Decisions and lifecycle events unchanged.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-007 — Missing or malformed explicit current-effectiveness evaluation context MUST be distinguishable from an invalid Decision.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-003 — Missing approval MUST be distinguishable from explicit rejection.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-008 — Invalid Approval Composition shape, empty stage lists or stages without declared groups, duplicate group or member declarations, duplicate declared quorum voter identities, quorum members without exactly one explicit voter or referencing child groups, unresolved member references, cycles, excessive nesting, invalid quorum thresholds, and missing or conflicting required current state/effectiveness evidence MUST use FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-009 — Approval Composition evaluation MUST reuse FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN for invalid structure or required state/effectiveness evidence, FINKORE_APPROVAL_CONDITION_UNRESOLVED for unresolved required applicability, and FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CONTEXT for missing or malformed required current-effectiveness evaluation context. A composing domain action blocked by unsatisfied approval MUST use FINKORE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED unless its governing domain specifies a more specific error. Composition MUST NOT introduce a quorum-specific portable error solely for these cases.
  • APPROVAL-ERROR-010 — When multiple Approval Composition validation failures coexist, evaluation MUST return the portable code for the highest-priority applicable failure category in this order: (1) invalid composition structure — FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN; (2) unresolved required applicability — FINKORE_APPROVAL_CONDITION_UNRESOLVED; (3) missing or malformed required evaluation context — FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CONTEXT; (4) missing or malformed required state/effectiveness evidence — FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN. Member order, stage order, or a potentially decisive group outcome MUST NOT change that priority.

Composition Error Priority

The priority in APPROVAL-ERROR-010 governs the returned code, not a prescribed software architecture. Category 1 applies to the declared composition structure; category 4 applies to required observation evidence after structure, applicability, and required context. Sharing INVALID_CHAIN does not give those categories the same priority. An implementation may return early only when no higher-priority applicable failure can change the code it returns.

For example, invalid structure takes precedence over unresolved applicability; unresolved applicability takes precedence over a missing required evaluation instant; missing required context takes precedence over malformed state evidence. A Decision whose expiration requires an evaluation instant uses INVALID_CONTEXT when that instant is missing or malformed. Missing member state alone uses INVALID_CHAIN. Opposing effective quorum votes under APPROVAL-QUORUM-009 are invalid evidence in category 4, not a structural failure in category 1. The context requirement itself follows Approval Validity; no ambient clock or invented context is permitted.

Failures within one category share its portable code. Optional diagnostics remain subject to APPROVAL-ERROR-004: they must not disclose restricted eligibility or Decision data. This priority does not require collecting or exposing every defect. A valid PENDING or REJECTED evaluation outcome is not itself a validation error; REQUIRED applies to a composing action blocked by that unsatisfied approval.

A quorum threshold is structurally invalid when it is not a positive integer or exceeds the declared membership before applicability evaluation. A valid quorum with at least one applicable member and insufficient remaining voting capacity has the REJECTED evaluation outcome under APPROVAL-QUORUM-006; reduced applicability alone does not produce FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN.

Invariants

Malformed condition or selector declarations and unsupported concrete fact values use FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_DECISION; unavailable facts for a valid condition use FINKORE_APPROVAL_CONDITION_UNRESOLVED. A record that would invalidate retained lifecycle references uses FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_DECISION under APPROVAL-VALIDITY-015 and leaves both histories unchanged. Missing quorum eligibility/outcome evidence uses FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN in composition category 4; disconnected cycles or unresolved declared references use category 1. Only composition has the total priority in APPROVAL-ERROR-010. Declaration validation before accepting a condition result does not create such a priority for all concrete Approval operations.

At concrete Requirement/Decision record and evaluation boundaries, malformed subject or eligibility declarations prevent a valid Decision and use FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_DECISION. Missing Decision subject association is also malformed Decision content under APPROVAL-DECISION-002, including in supplied concrete history. These are structural rejections, not eligibility failures or successful PENDING evaluations. FINKORE_APPROVAL_INELIGIBLE_ACTOR instead describes an Actor failing a valid eligibility rule. Valid historical Decisions can be ineffective for the currently evaluated Requirement without being structurally invalid.

The same invalid-Decision category applies when a consumer detects that a Decision history is being imported, evaluated, or used for lifecycle mutation outside the approval context or subject to which that history was immutably bound. The failed operation leaves both Decision and lifecycle histories unchanged under APPROVAL-ERROR-005 and APPROVAL-ERROR-006. This clarification adds no portable context-reference member and requires no global subject registry.

The stronger bounded reference requirements in APPROVAL-DECISION-013, APPROVAL-DECISION-014, and APPROVAL-VALIDITY-017 also use FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_DECISION for missing or malformed scoped references, cross-context or cross-subject association, duplicate Decision identity, and unresolved lifecycle identity. These conditions remain structural Decision evidence failures and preserve both histories; they do not create a registry or an authorization failure category.

This explains the existing invalid-Decision category and missing-subject/ missing-eligibility conformance outcomes; it adds no portable error. It does not impose a new total ordering of unrelated concrete Approval errors. The composition-only priority in APPROVAL-ERROR-010 remains unchanged, as do FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CONTEXT for required evaluation context and FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_CHAIN for malformed composition observations.

A caller-supplied concrete Decision effective member is malformed evidence under APPROVAL-VALIDITY-016 and uses FINKORE_APPROVAL_INVALID_DECISION. For a structurally valid Decision tied to the evaluated Requirement, an Actor excluded by its valid eligibility rule uses FINKORE_APPROVAL_INELIGIBLE_ACTOR even when lifecycle, expiration, or stale facts would otherwise make the Decision ineffective. Unrelated Decisions are not judged by the evaluated Requirement's eligibility rule.

A failed Approval operation must leave existing committed Approval Decisions and lifecycle events unchanged.

Open Questions

  • Should explicit rejection have its own portable blocking code?

Non-Goals

This catalog does not define authorization failures or transport representations.
